items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He had just left Artie Shaw... Do you remember that record he made with Artie Shaw...?

ctx.x: He had a band that was the greatest, I'm telling you. He had just left Artie Shaw, do you remember? He had arrangements... Do you remember that record he made with Artie Shaw...?
How long were you with him, do you think?
